title: Crypto Brief — 27 Nov 2026
intro: Cryptocurrency markets trade firmly in the green during the European session on Friday, 27 November 2026, with all major assets registering daily gains despite a softer backdrop in traditional equities. Risk appetite remains supported by steady buying across digital assets as market participants navigate a busy macroeconomic and geopolitical news cycle.

sections.heading: ETH/BTC 0.02796
sections.content:
8/10 alts beating BTC over 1W
1W best Litecoin +7.7% · worst Zcash -2.4%

sections.heading: Crypto theme
sections.content: Cross-asset flows highlight a divergence as gold rallies 4.66 percent and Bitcoin holds 61,575 amid ongoing geopolitical tensions in the Middle East and debates over US fiscal policy. Meanwhile, traditional tech equities struggle with the Nasdaq 100 down 0.64 percent, leaving crypto to trade largely on its own intraday momentum.

sections.heading: Bitcoin & Ether
sections.content: Bitcoin trades at 61,575, up 1.79 percent on the day and 0.6 percent over the week, maintaining its core structural range. Ethereum changes hands at 1,721.81, advancing 2.02 percent daily to bring the ETH/BTC ratio to 0.02796.

sections.heading: Altcoins
sections.content: Alternative assets display broad strength with 8 out of 10 tracked alts beating Bitcoin over the weekly timeframe, led by Litecoin gaining 7.7 percent and Zcash surging 10.89 percent on the day.

sections.heading: Potential scenarios
sections.content:
- *▲ Bullish · Bitcoin — above 62,200 opens 64,000 · invalid below 61,000*
Sustained spot demand pushing past immediate psychological resistance.
- *▼ Bearish · Ethereum — below 1,690.00 opens 1,620.00 · invalid above 1,750.00*
Broad macroeconomic pressure and tech sector weakness weighing on altcoin valuations.
- *▲ Bullish · Zcash — above 770.00 opens 810.00 · invalid below 730.00*
Heavy momentum-driven inflows extending today's double-digit percentage gains.

sections.heading: Key risks
sections.content:
- Geopolitical escalation in the Middle East affecting broader financial market sentiment.
- Spillover weakness from technology equities hitting the Nasdaq 100 during US trading hours.
